<parameter name="command">cd /tmp/defiformal-native-review-cthx3eyi && git cat-file -t c0f6f0bcc19ab30e0146a2e1e8ff209f8ce8c1a7 2>&1; git rev-parse HEAD 2>&1; git log --oneline -3 2>&1 | head -5</parameter>
<parameter name="description">Check candidate commit reachability</parameter>
</invoke>
<invoke name="Bash">
<parameter name="command">cd /tmp/defiformal-native-review-cthx3eyi && for f in openspec/changes/disjoint-parallel-composition/design.md openspec/changes/disjoint-parallel-composition/proposal.md openspec/changes/disjoint-parallel-composition/tasks.md openspec/changes/disjoint-parallel-composition/specs/parallel-compatibility/spec.md openspec/changes/disjoint-parallel-composition/specs/parallel-workflow-execution/spec.md openspec/changes/disjoint-parallel-composition/specs/parallel-preservation/spec.md openspec/changes/disjoint-parallel-composition/specs/parallel-regression-evidence/spec.md lean/DefiKernel/Typed/Transition.lean lean/DefiKernel/Composition/Interfaces.lean lean/DefiKernel/Composition/Execution.lean lean/DefiKernel/Composition/Sequence.lean; do if git cat-file -e c0f6f0bcc19ab30e0146a2e1e8ff209f8ce8c1a7:$f 2>/dev/null; then echo "$(git show c0f6f0bcc19ab30e0146a2e1e8ff209f8ce8c1a7:$f | sha256sum | cut -c1-16) $f"; else echo "MISSING $f"; fi; done</parameter>
